oracle_summary.kind: local source-pinned differential audit; not a sealed CI bundle

scope: These are strict explanations of retained raw changes, not IR normalization: the original oracle differences and bytes remain intact.
classification_rule: A path-only LLVM string change must have an exact own-checkout-home substitution, identical symbol/hash, and independently correct UTF-8 character count, byte count and both array bounds. The type-only rule permits only the three exact reviewed base enum type declarations.

review.rationale: SystemExit-derived Quit/Stop objects retain the existing message/args prefix and code/hc fields. Stop.__init__ initializes None as status 0 with hc=true, guards null before reading an enum tag, and sets hc/status from intlike-only tag arms. x.exit.Stop and x.exit.Quit still read those same code/hc slots; no conversion method is introduced.

Both base-typed direct sys.exit and stored SystemExit gain an intlike branch, preserving the alternate noninteger/None construction path and exception formatting. The final Quit(Status.FAILED) stores the immutable payload in existing code/hc fields and uses the unchanged subclass exit helper. No __index__ or __int__ call enters status selection.

Concrete Status.USAGE takes the existing null branch first, then loads the immutable Status slot 3 into pys_exc_exit. The previous message constructor on the nonnull member path is replaced; formatting remains in the existing EH form.

f.run adds status branches for IntEnum, computed/zero IntFlag, integer-mixin enums and base-typed views, including the stored SystemExit path. Concrete Status/Mixed payloads use slot 3 and Perm uses slot 5; tag-dispatch phis contain only intlike classes and a false/0 fallback. Plain Enum remains a message. Existing catch/finally dispatch remains; seven additional exit constructors correspond to the intended seven nonnull integer branches.

Base Enum dispatch tests concrete intlike tags, loading the appropriate payload only on matching arms. Plain.NINE reaches the false/0 phi fallback and existing message construction, preserving status 1 and its text.
Optional Status first branches on null; None keeps status 0 without dereference. The nonnull path reads immutable slot 3 and constructs the integer exit status.
The same intlike tag dispatch excludes Plain despite its __index__/__int__ methods. No call to either conversion hook is emitted; the plain member retains its custom message route.

The declared FAILED member initializes mutable _value_ slot 4 and immutable payload slot 3 to 3; ALIAS reuses that member. The user mutation stores 9 only in slot 4, while exit loads slot 3. Alias identity is preserved.

The accepted wide value 4611686018427387907 is stored as the same i64 in payload slot 3 and metadata slot 4 in this python-int module. Later metadata mutation writes only slot 4. Exit passes the stored i64 to the existing runtime status helper; no arbitrary-precision expansion or conversion-hook call is introduced.

Literal hidden-slot hasattr arms remain false and literal getattr evaluates the default once before returning it; dynamic reflection call targets are unchanged. The reflection helper changes only existing field offsets/TBAA and renumbered constants due to the inserted payload. No new reflected payload entry is introduced. Final sys.exit(Status.OK) reads the immutable zero payload.

Base-typed status() dispatch includes Status and other intlike enum classes, reads slot 3 on Status, and passes its stored 293 to the existing runtime status handling. Pure custom __str__ remains formatting, not status conversion; __index__/__int__ are not called.

The SUCCESS alias shares the zero-valued member and the nonnull path loads immutable slot 3. Presence is tested by nullness/class, not integer truthiness, so zero remains a valid status despite conversion overrides.

Declared flag members initialize payload slot 5; computed member creation in _missing_ copies the same creation value to metadata slot 3 and payload slot 5. Later writes of 9/8 change only metadata. Base Enum dispatch selects Perm slot 5 for the combined member, preserving its creation value and alias identity.

Computed Perm(0) uses the same _missing_ initialization for payload slot 5. A metadata write of 9 changes slot 3 only. The nonnull exit path loads slot 5, keeping status zero and ignoring integer conversion overrides.
